name: nextjs-demo
description: Standalone Next.js App Router SSG showcase proving @ngeenx/nx-react-code-viewer renders at build time and hydrates. Installed in isolation (pnpm install --ignore-workspace) so it never touches the root monorepo lockfile. It consumes the BUILT @ngeenx/nx-react-code-viewer dist, so rebuild that lib first if its source changes.
